notes: Target: replace current multi-tenant endpoints with dedicated pool for latency-sensitive ad-ranking flows.
Key ask from CTO: 10ms median latency for short-chat & reranking under steady-state; burst capacity to handle 6k RPS during campaign spikes.
POC scope agreed: 2-week load/soak + model variant fallback tests + failure injection (node drain, kernel OOM).
Representative prompts: short rerank candidates (~40 tokens), contextual personalization prompts (~120-300 tokens), high-throughput embedding batches (up to 512 queries/batch).

Performance targets: P50 <= 12ms for short prompts, P95 <= 45ms, P99 <= 120ms under baseline 3-machine dedicated pool. Throughput target 4k concurrency-equivalent (continuous), burst up to 6k for 5 minutes.

Reserved GPU plan: initial proposal 3x A10G-equivalent nodes with headroom; evaluate 4x for lower P95. Explore quantized 4-bit runs for embeddings path to increase throughput with minimal quality loss.
Routing/fallback needs: prefer model-v1 (fp16) for quality; fallback to model-v1-quant (4-bit) or model-v0.9 on overload; routing must be region-aware (NA primary, EU failover).
Security: require SSO/SAML + SCIM, customer-managed KMS for key material, audit logging with 180d retention, and EU data residency for PII in ad personalization flows.
Integration notes: Meridian uses internal traffic generator (mgen) and a Prometheus + Grafana stack. Want Redwood metrics exported via Prometheus endpoint during POC.
Quotes from CTO: 'We need predictable tail latency — marketing spikes cannot break click-through pipelines.'

poc_plan: Phase 1 (baseline): synthetic load to characterize latency curves across short/med/long prompts; measure P50/P95/P99; run 6-hour ramp tests.
Phase 2 (soak): 48-hour continuous steady-state at target throughput (4k equiv), monitor memory/KV cache behavior and cumulative degradation.
Phase 3 (stress & failover): trigger node drains, unplanned restarts, model fallback routing; verify SLA fallbacks and SLO breach alarms.
Phase 4 (quality): run Meridian-provided eval set to detect regressions when switching to 4-bit quantized variants; threshold: <1% nDCG drop on reranker.
Deliverables: raw Prometheus metrics, token-level cost breakouts, latency percentiles, GPU utilization, KV-cache hit rates, and recommended reserved GPU commit.
Acceptance criteria: P95 <= 45ms for short prompts under steady-state; end-to-end regression <1% on rerank eval set; documented GPU sizing to meet 99.9% uptime target.
